sources.title: NoGraphicsAPI README
sources.notes: C++20, Vulkan 1.4 and Metal 4 implementation; required Vulkan extensions exceed core 1.4. Driver compatibility table is explicitly a September 2026 snapshot.

sources.title: NoGraphicsAPI public interface
